manual_output_review.scope: Direct review of all 18 development pipeline outputs and all 12 fresh integration outputs. This is not a psychologist assessment.

findings.issue: Awkward and unclear Turkish; assumes morning context not stated by the user.
Suggests a small breakfast or hot drink before sleep; cited care-3 does not contain those suggestions.
Suggests the assistant may evaluate consultation with a specialist, an unclear capability claim.
Incoherent response to bereavement, including unrelated advice to clean oneself.
Grammatical Turkish fragments do not form a coherent response to the user's concern.
The proposed boundary reverses the user's requested timing; care-8 does not substantiate that advice.
Long, incoherent boundary explanation; source link does not support the generated instructions.
Unclear language and misleading suggestion that the assistant needs to consult a specialist.

manual_output_review.decision: Keep generation disabled in both languages. Automated format, language identity and routing scores do not establish coherent or source-supported responses.
next_work: Benchmark a stronger multilingual open-weight candidate before spending more training on this base.
Expand permitted synthetic examples and grounded-response evaluation; retain these failures as regression cases.
Strengthen citation entailment and semantic review. Use fresh unseen scenarios after changes.
Measure deployment GPU quotas and memory separately from local training; owner acceptance remains last before publication.
